name: workload-policy-repair-v1
claim: Repair poor generalization to fresh workloads, not compiler-induced degradation

training.rule: Fit target-only forest from all twelve cases using fixed original hyperparameters; no search or tuning

direct_patch.scope: Agent-authored code patch to harness scheduling choice; not a human-maintenance comparator
direct_patch.data_access: Exactly the same block-one72 target action rows as refit, compiler/feature/action descriptions and frozen source policy artifact; no block-two outcomes, no test specifications/outcomes, no additional source labels

evaluation.partitions: Target adaptation6 and test12 as specified by shift_design; historical audit6 are now training data
evaluation.secondary: direct_patch versus unchanged_source_forest; target_refit versus direct_patch
evaluation.gate: Both blocks require runtime ratio<0.95, mean paired group-balanced log improvement beyond max(log1.02,3MAD), and at least4/6 recipe groups faster. Same rule per declared comparison.
evaluation.stop: Evaluate one frozen repair per arm once on twelve fresh cases; no post-test tuning regardless of result
evaluation.dispersion: MAD across11 round-level group-balanced natural-log ratios; within each round average two case log ratios per recipe, then six recipe means; mean those11 logs for aggregate improvement

prior_negative_result: Compiler-shift gate failed; target/source regret did not worsen. This new experiment addresses workload generalization separately and preserves original negative report.

jev_reference.packet: Same frozen 42-feature informed packet; no adaptation labels in prompt
jev_reference.purpose: General pretrained decision prior versus outcome-trained local refit; distinct data access reported explicitly
jev_reference.aggregation: Mean selected runtimes across three frozen responses within each case and round, then grouped log-ratio comparisons; never choose best response
jev_reference.failure: Retain failures; if any slot unavailable after attempts, Jev reference unavailable for the experiment; local primary and patch comparisons continue
jev_reference.comparison: Predeclared secondary Jev versus target_refit using same quality gate; no routing trained on test outcomes
